manual.description: Starts an Agent 6 admin/test-only maintenance action requested from the Cockpit's Admin Functions panel. Never called by the 5 production agents.

VAR_InitiatedBy.description: User who started the admin action.

VAR_RequestedAction.description: Identifies which admin/test-only action to run (e.g. DeleteProcessedMailsFolderTree). Extensible for future admin actions such as archive-folder renaming.

VAR_ResultSuccess.description: Tracks whether the requested admin action completed successfully.

VAR_ResultMessage.description: Human-readable result text returned to the Cockpit.

VAR_DeletedFolderNames.description: Buffers the display names of folders actually deleted, for the result message.

VAR_AuditOutcome.description: Stores this run's final outcome (Succeeded/Failed), derived from the requested admin action's own result once it has completed.

VAR_WorkflowPath.description: Identifies this flow's path in the audit trail and dashboard status row.

VAR_NewRunsCount.description: Holds the incremented Runs counter value while writing it to Agent Audit Summary.

GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads the active DMP COMMAND configuration items needed to resolve the correct mailbox and folder name for the current operating mode.

FILTER_Config_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds the current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

VAR_OperationMode.description: Stores the current DMP COMMAND operation mode, so the correct (PROD vs SIMU) mailbox is targeted rather than accidentally deleting folders in the wrong mailbox.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, matching the same resolution logic used by the production agents.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central configuration object for this run.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Unknown or unsupported admin action requested: ''', variables('RequestedAction'), '''.')

SET_ResultMessage_UnknownAction.description: Reports an unrecognized admin action back to the Cockpit instead of silently doing nothing.

GET_Matching_ProcessedMails_Folders.description: Finds the 'PA Processed Mails' root folder and any stray duplicates (e.g. 'PA Processed Mails2') by matching on a name prefix, so the whole tree can be reset for testing.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('No folder(s) matching ''', trim(string(outputs('CMP_ConfigObject')?['ProcessedMailsRootFolderName'])), '*'' found under Inbox - nothing to delete.')

SET_ResultMessage_NothingToDelete.description: Reports that there was nothing to delete, which counts as a successful outcome.

SET_ResultSuccess_NothingToDelete.description: Marks the run as successful since there was no folder to clean up.

DELETE_Folder.description: Deletes (moves to Deleted Items, recoverable) the matched folder together with all its subfolders and content.

APPEND_DeletedFolderNames.description: Records the display name of each folder that was actually deleted.

SET_ResultMessage_Deleted.description: Reports the full list of deleted folders back to the Cockpit.

SET_ResultSuccess_Deleted.description: Marks the run as successful after all matched folders were deleted.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Deletion stopped after an error. Successfully removed ', string(length(variables('DeletedFolderNames'))), ' folder(s) so far: ', join(variables('DeletedFolderNames'), ', '), '. Check the Power Automate run history for details.')

SET_ResultMessage_PartialFailure.description: Reports a partial failure so the Cockpit does not falsely claim full success.

SET_ResultSuccess_PartialFailure.description: Marks the run as failed when not all matched folders could be deleted.

IF_NoMatchingFoldersFound.description: Skips the delete loop entirely (and reports success) when no 'PA Processed Mails' folder currently exists, instead of treating an already-clean mailbox as an error.

GET_CounterRow_NoDMP.description: Reads the current 'No DMP' counter row from the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list before resetting it, so the previous value is captured for the Audit Trail (Operational History).

PATCH_CounterRow_NoDMP.description: Resets the 'No DMP' counter to 0 in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list.

SET_ResultMessage_ResetNoDMP.description: Records the before-value in the result message, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetNoDMP.description: Marks the counter reset as successful.

GET_CounterRow_InternalSender.description: Reads the current 'DMP internal Sender' counter row from the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list before resetting it, so the previous value is captured for the Audit Trail (Operational History).

PATCH_CounterRow_InternalSender.description: Resets the 'DMP internal Sender' counter to 0 in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list.

SET_ResultMessage_ResetInternalSender.description: Records the before-value in the result message, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetInternalSender.description: Marks the counter reset as successful.

GET_CounterRow_Effected.description: Reads the current 'DMP effected Member' counter row from the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list before resetting it, so the previous value is captured for the Audit Trail (Operational History).

PATCH_CounterRow_Effected.description: Resets the 'DMP effected Member' counter to 0 in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list.

SET_ResultMessage_ResetEffected.description: Records the before-value in the result message, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetEffected.description: Marks the counter reset as successful.

GET_CounterRow_NotEffected.description: Reads the current 'DMP not effected Sender' counter row from the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list before resetting it, so the previous value is captured for the Audit Trail (Operational History).

PATCH_CounterRow_NotEffected.description: Resets the 'DMP not effected Sender' counter to 0 in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Counter ''DMP not effected Sender'' reset from ', coalesce(string(first(body('GET_CounterRow_NotEffected')?['value'])?['NumberProcessedEmails']), '0'), ' to 0.')

SET_ResultMessage_ResetNotEffected.description: Records the before-value in the result message, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetNotEffected.description: Marks the counter reset as successful.

GET_CounterRow_All_NoDMP.description: Reads the current 'No DMP' counter row before resetting all counters.

PATCH_CounterRow_All_NoDMP.description: Resets the 'No DMP' counter to 0 as part of resetting all counters.

GET_CounterRow_All_InternalSender.description: Reads the current 'DMP internal Sender' counter row before resetting all counters.

PATCH_CounterRow_All_InternalSender.description: Resets the 'DMP internal Sender' counter to 0 as part of resetting all counters.

GET_CounterRow_All_Effected.description: Reads the current 'DMP effected Member' counter row before resetting all counters.

PATCH_CounterRow_All_Effected.description: Resets the 'DMP effected Member' counter to 0 as part of resetting all counters.

GET_CounterRow_All_NotEffected.description: Reads the current 'DMP not effected Sender' counter row before resetting all counters.

PATCH_CounterRow_All_NotEffected.description: Resets the 'DMP not effected Sender' counter to 0 as part of resetting all counters.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('All counters reset to 0. Previous values - No DMP: ', coalesce(string(first(body('GET_CounterRow_All_NoDMP')?['value'])?['NumberProcessedEmails']), '0'), ', DMP internal Sender: ', coalesce(string(first(body('GET_CounterRow_All_InternalSender')?['value'])?['NumberProcessedEmails']), '0'), ', DMP effected Member: ', coalesce(string(first(body('GET_CounterRow_All_Effected')?['value'])?['NumberProcessedEmails']), '0'), ', DMP not effected Sender: ', coalesce(string(first(body('GET_CounterRow_All_NotEffected')?['value'])?['NumberProcessedEmails']), '0'), '.')

SET_ResultMessage_ResetAll.description: Records all 4 before-values in the result message, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetAll.description: Marks the reset-all-counters action as successful.

GET_AuditSummary_ForCriticalBaseline_Age.description: Reads Agent 1's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical (Failed) total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 2's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical (Failed) total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 3's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical (Failed) total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 4's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical (Failed) total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 5's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical (Failed) total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 6's own row from Agent Audit Summary. Tolerated as Failed downstream so a not-yet-seeded row never blocks the reset.

CMP_CurrentCriticalTotal_ForReset.description: Sums the FailedStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows - this is the same lifetime Critical total shown by the Cockpit, used here as the new baseline.

GET_CriticalBaselineRow.description: Checks whether the CriticalCounterBaseline row already exists in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list (it does not exist until the first reset is ever performed).

PATCH_CriticalBaselineRow.description: Updates the existing CriticalCounterBaseline row to the current total, so the Cockpit's Critical KPI shows 0 new until the next Critical event.

CREATE_CriticalBaselineRow.description: Creates the CriticalCounterBaseline row on first use (this is the first time a Critical reset has ever been performed).

IF_CriticalBaselineRow_Exists.description: Creates the baseline row on first use, otherwise updates the existing one.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Critical counter reset - current lifetime total is ', string(outputs('CMP_CurrentCriticalTotal_ForReset')), '. The Cockpit''s Critical KPI now shows 0 and will only increase again for new Critical events from this point on.')

SET_ResultMessage_ResetCriticalBaseline.description: Records the reset outcome, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetCriticalBaseline.description: Marks the Critical counter baseline reset as successful.

GET_AuditSummary_ForWarningBaseline_Agen.description: Reads Agent 1's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Warning total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 2's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Warning total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 3's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Warning total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 4's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Warning total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 5's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Warning total before resetting the Cockpit's 'new since reset' baseline.
Reads Agent 6's own row from Agent Audit Summary. Tolerated as Failed downstream so a not-yet-seeded row never blocks the reset.

CMP_CurrentWarningTotal_ForReset.description: Sums the WarningStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows - this is the same lifetime Warning total shown by the Cockpit, used here as the new baseline.

GET_WarningBaselineRow.description: Checks whether the WarningCounterBaseline row already exists in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list (it does not exist until the first reset is ever performed).

PATCH_WarningBaselineRow.description: Updates the existing WarningCounterBaseline row to the current total, so the Cockpit's Warning KPI shows 0 new until the next Warning event.

CREATE_WarningBaselineRow.description: Creates the WarningCounterBaseline row on first use (this is the first time a Warning reset has ever been performed).

IF_WarningBaselineRow_Exists.description: Creates the baseline row on first use, otherwise updates the existing one.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Warning counter reset - current lifetime total is ', string(outputs('CMP_CurrentWarningTotal_ForReset')), '. The Cockpit''s Warning KPI now shows 0 and will only increase again for new Warning events from this point on.')

SET_ResultMessage_ResetWarningBaseline.description: Records the reset outcome, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetWarningBaseline.description: Marks the Warning counter baseline reset as successful.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent01.description: Reads Agent 1's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical and Warning totals before resetting both Cockpit baselines.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent02.description: Reads Agent 2's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical and Warning totals before resetting both Cockpit baselines.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent03.description: Reads Agent 3's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical and Warning totals before resetting both Cockpit baselines.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent04.description: Reads Agent 4's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical and Warning totals before resetting both Cockpit baselines.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent05.description: Reads Agent 5's row from Agent Audit Summary to compute the current lifetime Critical and Warning totals before resetting both Cockpit baselines.

GET_AuditSummary_ForAllBaseline_Agent06.description: Reads Agent 6's own row from Agent Audit Summary. Tolerated as Failed downstream so a not-yet-seeded row never blocks the reset.

CMP_CurrentCriticalTotal_ForAllReset.description: Sums the FailedStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows - the current lifetime Critical total, used as the new Critical baseline.

CMP_CurrentWarningTotal_ForAllReset.description: Sums the WarningStepsCount column across all 6 agent rows - the current lifetime Warning total, used as the new Warning baseline.

GET_AllBaselineRows.description: Checks whether the CriticalCounterBaseline and/or WarningCounterBaseline rows already exist in the DMP Command Counters SharePoint list.

PATCH_CriticalBaselineRow_ForAllReset.description: Updates the existing CriticalCounterBaseline row to the current total.

CREATE_CriticalBaselineRow_ForAllReset.description: Creates the CriticalCounterBaseline row on first use.

IF_CriticalBaselineRow_Exists_ForAllRese.description: Creates the Critical baseline row on first use, otherwise updates the existing one.

PATCH_WarningBaselineRow_ForAllReset.description: Updates the existing WarningCounterBaseline row to the current total.

CREATE_WarningBaselineRow_ForAllReset.description: Creates the WarningCounterBaseline row on first use.

IF_WarningBaselineRow_Exists_ForAllReset.description: Creates the Warning baseline row on first use, otherwise updates the existing one.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: @concat('Critical and Warning counters reset - current lifetime totals were Critical: ', string(outputs('CMP_CurrentCriticalTotal_ForAllReset')), ', Warning: ', string(outputs('CMP_CurrentWarningTotal_ForAllReset')), '. Both Cockpit KPIs now show 0 and will only increase again for new events from this point on.')

SET_ResultMessage_ResetAllAuditBaselines.description: Records the reset outcome, which the existing run-summary step then writes to the Audit Trail (Operational History).

SET_ResultSuccess_ResetAllAuditBaselines.description: Marks the combined Critical+Warning counter baseline reset as successful.

SWITCH_RequestedAction.description: Dispatches to the requested admin/test-only action. Extensible: future admin actions (e.g. renaming a folder for archiving) can be added as additional cases without touching the delete logic.

SET_AuditOutcome_FromResult.description: Determines the final AuditOutcome from the admin action's own result, mirroring Agent 4's pattern since Agent 6 has one linear action rather than granular branching.

SCOPE_AuditTrail_Write.description: Writes a single run-summary row for this admin action to the central audit trail.

WRITE_RunSummary_To_AuditTrail.description: Writes the run summary for this admin action to the central audit trail.

SCOPE_AuditSummary_Write.description: Increments Agent 6's own Runs counter in Agent Audit Summary after the admin action has completed.

GET_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Reads Agent 6's current Runs counters from Agent Audit Summary.

SET_NewRunsCount.description: Computes the incremented Runs counter value based on this run's final AuditOutcome.

PATCH_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Persists the incremented Runs counter and its last-update timestamp back to Agent Audit Summary.

SCOPE_StatusRow_Update.description: Updates the Agent_06 dashboard status row after the admin action has completed.

GET_StatusRow_Agent_06.description: Reads the Agent_06 dashboard status record from DMP Command Agent Status.

UPDATE_StatusRow_Agent_06.description: Updates the operational dashboard status for Agent 6 after completing the requested admin action.

RESPOND_Result.description: Returns the admin action's result to the Cockpit's Admin Functions panel.
